machine: Apple M1 (ANGLE Metal renderer), Claude desktop app browser pane, 1024x768 CSS px, devicePixelRatio 2 (renderer pixel ratio capped at 1 / 1.5 / 2 by quality)
method: window.__meos.resetPerf() after warm-up, then 240 requestAnimationFrame frames; frame time is the true (unclamped) interval; 'playing' = the simulation clock running at 12 ticks/s
note: the frame rate is vsync-limited at 60 fps: no headroom figure can be read from it; one machine, one browser
software_rendering: headless Chromium on SwiftShader (used only for the screenshot captures) renders in the order of seconds per frame at 1672x808 and is not a performance measurement of the view; the perf-*.json files next to the captures are its readings
